messages:
aisha (Marketing): Quick sync — NorthBridge case study timeline. Customer agreed to a 30-min recorded interview next Wed at 10am PT. Need final quote + legal signoff before publish. Can we lock this down?
ethan (PM): Nice. Do we have the benchmark numbers they'd be comfortable sharing? want to pull one stat for the launch post + webinar slide.
ravi (Design): I can draft hero image and pull quote layout once we have the approved quote. pref to get high-res logo + preferred casing from them.
clara (Legal): @aisha thanks — checklist: release form signed, brand guidelines, any redlined quote text flagged, and confirm no ongoing NDAs that block public mention. I can do a quick review within 24 hrs if assets + draft quote are in by EOD Tue.
aisha (Marketing): Copy. I'll send release form now, and ask for final quote copy from the customer. ETA Tue EOD. 
tom (Sales): Heads up — customer asked to avoid referencing competitor names in the quote. also requested a one-sentence technical caveat about latency variability on long seqs. thought: we can include a neutral line like "typical latency for our workloads" instead. 
ethan (PM): For the benchmark stat, they were happy with our internal run showing ~2.1x cost per token improvement on their prompt mix. can we phrase it as "~2x cost reduction for their typical prompt distribution"? less precise but safe.
clara (Legal): That phrasing sounds fine, but please add a source note: "based on Redwood Inference config X (batching + kv-cache) on 8xA100)." we need the configuration callout to avoid misleading claims.
aisha (Marketing): Good — I'll draft quote: "With Redwood Inference we saw ~2x reduction in inference cost on our typical prompts, enabling wider feature rollout." will send to customer for approval and cc @clara.
ravi (Design): If we get an approved short quote, I can mock a social card + webinar slide. Any preference on quote length? 20 words or less works best for hero.
tom (Sales): Keep it short. Also ask them for 1-2 measurable outcomes (time-to-market, feature usage, or cost) we can anonymize in case they want that.
clara (Legal): Reminder: please attach the proposed social copy and one-sentence technical descriptor when you send to them. I'll flag any problematic language in-thread to speed approval.
aisha (Marketing): Sent the release form (link: https://rbwd.app/release-forms/nb). pinged customer for quote + logo. putting a rough schedule: Tue EOD assets -> Wed legal review -> Thurs design -> Fri publish + webinar promo next Tue. 
calendar-bot: Meeting created: NorthBridge interview — Wed 10:00am PT. Invite sent to customer + aisha + tom.
tom (Sales): FYI I'll prep a short pre-call doc with 3 suggested questions (value, integration, outcome) and share here.
aisha (Marketing): Perfect. If all goes green, we'll also route inbound MQLs from the post to the dedicated SDR queue — tagging flow: marketing->sales->northbridge-sdr. need ops to confirm routing by Thurs.
ethan (PM): One more: can we avoid specific throughput numbers? keep it scoped to cost and time-to-market. we don't want customers testing our limits in the forum.
aisha (Marketing): Agreed. I'll keep numbers high-level and include the configuration footnote per @clara. Will post the draft quote here when it lands. :thumbsup:
